content.title: Blackbird / WhatsAppWrapped
content.detail: WhatsAppWrapped sits in the Surry Hills / Blackbird block because that camp is where the museum-style idea became a real product surface: local parsing, recap cards, and the first archive walk.
Jashby gets the spreadsheet campus: the long-running founder thread around turning Excel and Google Sheets learning into levels, daily challenges, onboarding, analytics, and real user loops.

content.title: Quantium Work Experience
content.summary: An Eveleigh-side data tower for the Quantium work-experience week around CommBank iQ analytics and market-data scraping.
content.detail: This is mapped around Eveleigh rather than as a generic office block. It anchors the analytics side of the portfolio: client data, market signals, and a scraper built in a professional context.

content.title: My House
content.summary: Home: the Dover Heights house this whole map is drawn from, up on the coast near Bondi.
content.detail: This gives the portfolio city a personal origin instead of floating in generic tech-land. It sits above the beach and looks back toward the project blocks.

content.title: Moriah College
content.summary: The Bondi Junction school where most of this trail started: HSC study tools, school projects, and the jiu-jitsu comp app.
content.detail: Moriah College is the school in Bondi Junction Jake finishes in 2026. It earns a place on the map because so much of the archive traces back to it: the HSC study software, the Moriah Jiu-Jitsu competition site built for the school's program, and the years of side projects around them.

content.title: Bondi Beach
content.summary: A bright coastal strip for the beach part of the world: sand, surf, boards, and the city edge.
content.detail: Bondi is treated as landscape, not decoration. It gives the mini city a real east-Sydney coastline and a natural place for the Dover Heights home marker.

content.title: Sydney Harbour / Opera House
content.summary: The harbour corner with Opera House-style sails, a bridge arch, and CBD skyline massing.
content.detail: This anchors the map in Sydney before the project buildings take over. It is deliberately literal: water, sails, bridge, skyline.

content.title: Dover Garage / Car Lifestory
content.detail: Car Lifestory sits by the Dover Heights home marker because the product starts from a real car-history problem: ownership paperwork, service records, costs, exports, and scan-to-form entry.
What The Puck sits beside the football pitch as the public-game landmark: Unity, C#, mobile launch work, and the first project here that shipped to app stores.
The Moriah Jiu-Jitsu tool is placed in the Queens Park school block because it is an operational Moriah sport system: divisions, athletes, scoring, leaderboards, and live competition admin.
Degree6 becomes the network interchange: a D3 graph tool for searching and exploring degrees of separation through LinkedIn-style relationship data.
Idea Aid stays as the early AI workshop: a CS50 Flask app where prompts, SQL, auth, Bootstrap, and the OpenAI API first became an actual user-facing generator.

content.title: Town Hall / Jake Glick Portfolio
content.detail: The portfolio itself is the town hall, sitting in the city core: a live map of the work, the Sydney context, the contact route, and the archive underneath it.
